mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months (measured as the change in FEDFUNDS) predicts positive 5-day S&P 500 returns, as lower rates reduce discount rates for equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained annualized CPIAUCSL growth rate above 2.5% per annum signals inflationary pressure that increases equity risk premiums, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns in periods of CPIAUCSL annualized growth > 2.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% and housing starts (HOUST) rise above 1400.0, it signals a strong labor market and robust housing demand, which together predict positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to elevated consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns in periods meeting UNRATE < 4.0 AND HOUST > 1400.0 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by GDP growth > 2.0% QoQ and unemployment < 4.0%), a federal funds rate above 3.5% signals impending monetary tightening, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns in periods meeting the late-cycle regime condition (GDPC1 QoQ > 2.0% and UNRATE < 4.0%) and FEDFUNDS > 3.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500.0, it signals robust residential construction and consumer confidence, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns in periods of HOUST > 1500.0 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 102.0, it signals strong manufacturing activity and economic growth, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns in periods of INDPRO > 102.0 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% and industrial production (INDPRO) rises above 102.0, it signals a tight labor market and strong manufacturing output, which together predict positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns in periods meeting UNRATE < 4.0 AND INDPRO > 102.0 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that reduces the risk of recession and increases corporate earnings, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns in periods of UNRATE < 4.0 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
